_comment: Policy for lib/system_sender.py. Joe's ruling 6624fed2 (2026-10-21): no marketing or mass mail; individually written, low-pressure, one-to-one outreach only, at most ten per day. Calls require Joe's ask or an authorized category (c5ac0e0c). The shared chain enforces kill switch, writing lint, recipient allowlist and existing suppression records, dedupe, daily caps, shadow mode and receipts. Calendar invitations use the mail chain and budget. Social delivery keeps its existing policy. A null or future live_from retains shadow mode.
_note: LIVE ON MERGE OVER AN UNPROVEN TRANSPORT, SAID PLAINLY: Joe's standing ruling is no shadow mode on an obvious improvement, so live_from stays in the past. The Outlook keystroke path (bin/outlook-send.applescript) and the Blotato post had never sent a real message when this shipped, so the FIRST CALLER IS THE LIVE TEST. The first live send must be lib.system_sender.send_self_test(subject, body), a mail to mail.self_test_address (Joe's own, already allowlisted) through the whole chain, so the transport is proven on a self-send before any participant mail. STATE IS PER MACHINE: the dedupe ledger, sends.jsonl and the stop file live in state_dir (default ~/carr-local/system-sender, created mode 700, outside every checkout; the CARR_SYSTEM_SENDER_STATE_DIR environment variable overrides it for tests). Every checkout and worktree on one machine shares them, so dedupe and the daily caps are per MACHINE, not global; the stop file stops this machine only. The record-layer system_send_stop signal remains the GLOBAL kill switch. Mail permits at most one external recipient and ten daily sends, including calendar invites. Existing party and lead suppression instructions are read live for every address. The whole config is validated when a Sender is built; a malformed value refuses every send (reason config_invalid) before anything is claimed.

mail._self_addresses_note: Joe's and Dell's own CARR addresses, the same pair bin/gmail-handover.py allows. Any other recipient must be an exact participant email on the deal named in the call, read live through get-call-context.

social._platforms_note: A platform must be listed here AND carry an accountId in accounts_file; the account and page ids come from that file, never from the caller.

kill_switch._note: Either one stops every send: the stop file (a bare name inside state_dir; stops THIS machine) existing, or an open or claimed record-layer signal of this kind (read through next-signals; stops EVERY machine). A kill-switch read that fails refuses the send.

_state_note: receipts_file and ledger_file are bare names inside state_dir. The ledger holds the dedupe keys AND today's cap slots, reserved under one lock at claim time.
